question: Which of the following forest types is found on the foothills of the Himalayas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Decidious.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deciduous forests:-**

 
 
• **The forest type found on the foothills of the Himalayas is the deciduous forest, which is characterized by trees that shed their leaves seasonally.**
 
• These forests are also known as the Terai-Duar savanna and grasslands and are found in the lowlands of the Himalayan foothills in India, Nepal, and Bhutan.
 
• The deciduous forests of the Himalayan foothills are home to a diverse range of flora and fauna, including tigers, elephants, deer, and various species of birds and reptiles.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Temperate forests:-**

 
 
• The temperate forests are found in cooler regions with moderate rainfall.
 
 
 
• **Tundra:-**
 
 
• It is a cold and treeless biome found in high latitudes.
 
 
 
• **Alpine forests:-**
 
 
• The alpine forests are found in high-altitude regions above the tree line.
